name: Jákfa (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Jákfa: a blue shield with a white arm holding a sabre, a star and a crescent, with a helm, a crest and red, blue and white mantling, within a green wreath.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Jákfa arms with helm, crest, mantling and wreath
